products.name: Android Cinema Projector Ultra Bundle
products.blurb: Fully loaded Android cinema kit. Netflix ready, ceiling rotation, up to 130 inches.
products.description: Turn any wall or ceiling into a private cinema. This is the Unique Claims Ultra Bundle: a fully loaded Android projector, set up so you are not fighting menus on night one. Netflix comes ready, the system is unlocked for movies, series and anime, and the picture swings from the front wall up to the ceiling so you can watch lying in bed. Dual-band Wi-Fi, Bluetooth 5.0, phone mirroring, auto keystone and auto focus. Collection in Mandeville or islandwide delivery.
features: Scales up to 130 inches on any blank wall
One-touch phone mirroring from iPhone or Android
Loaded for movies, series and anime

products.name: HY300 Pro+ Fully Loaded
products.blurb: The house projector. Compact, loaded, and paired for big-screen nights.
products.description: The HY300 Pro+ package Unique Claims builds for Jamaican homes. Compact body, bright enough for evening movie nights, and loaded before it leaves Mandeville so the first night is the movie, not the setup. HDMI for console gaming, Bluetooth for a speaker, and phone mirroring for TikToks and photos on the wall.
features: HDMI for PS5, Xbox and Switch

products.name: Portable 4G Car Hotspot
products.blurb: Wi-Fi in the car. Digicel or Flow SIM. 4G speed, pocket size.
products.description: A pocket modem that turns a Digicel or Flow SIM into Wi-Fi for the car, the yard, or a stall. 4G speed anywhere the SIM has signal. Useful for the projector on the road, for passengers, and for work when home Wi-Fi is down.
features: Works with Digicel and Flow SIMs
Pocket size for car or bag
Share with phones, tablets and the projector

products.name: 100-inch Foldable Screen
products.blurb: A clean white surface when the wall is busy. Folds into a bag.
products.description: When the wall has texture, windows or a busy paint colour, a foldable screen keeps the picture crisp. Pairs with either projector. Easy to hang for a movie night and pack away after.
features: Better contrast than a painted wall
Made to pair with the Ultra Bundle

products.name: Tripod + Ceiling Angle Kit
products.blurb: Stable stand so the picture stays put, including the bed-view angle.
products.description: A steady tripod kit so the projector is not balanced on a book. Height adjusts for the front wall or the ceiling angle. The small piece that makes the Ultra Bundle feel finished.
features: Stable for wall or ceiling angle
Packs with the projector for travel

products.name: Bluetooth Party Speaker
products.blurb: Bigger sound than the built-in speaker. Pairs in one tap.
products.description: The projector already has sound. This is for when the yard is full. Bluetooth pairs to the Ultra Bundle or a phone. Good for movie night and a cookout after.
